subject.title: Fix live orphan session transcript visibility

question: Should OpenClaw accept owner-scoped `sessions/<agent>/<stem>.jsonl` paths as enough authority to synthesize same-agent session keys when the combined session store has no entry?
rationale: The code change is narrow and tested, but the choice changes the transcript visibility boundary for missing-store live sessions and cannot be reduced to a mechanical repair.

options.title: Accept scoped fallback
options.body: Merge after maintainer review agrees that same-agent owner-scoped paths are trusted enough and cross-agent plus legacy basename paths remain fail-closed.

options.title: Require persisted identity
options.body: Keep live orphan hits hidden unless memory indexing has persisted artifact/session identity, avoiding synthetic live keys from paths.

recommendation.title: Accept scoped fallback
recommendation.body: Merge after maintainer review agrees that same-agent owner-scoped paths are trusted enough and cross-agent plus legacy basename paths remain fail-closed.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent current-main history and adjacent archive-visibility safety work make this the best available owner for the visibility-boundary call.
